integrity: The proofs and checker address the stated local unit-circle spectral boundary only. The existing equal-drive boundary and period-two formulas are cited as prior results. Independent external scientific verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local in unequal-drive mismatch for each fixed coupling b in (-1,0); the curve is spectral (unit-circle multipliers) and no global stability, invariant-circle existence or nonresonant normal form at strong resonances is asserted. Fourth-order response at the two zero-curvature couplings is uncomputed; historical priority is not independently determined.
title: Two sign reversals in the mismatch curvature of a coupled quadratic-map unit-circle boundary
